description: Generate a production-quality smart contract from a natural language description. Supports EVM (Solidity) and Solana (Anchor/Rust or SPL Token config). The generator uses Pentagonal's self-learning security rules to produce safer code.

prompt.description: Natural language description of the smart contract to generate. Be specific about features, access control, and tokenomics.

solana_type.description: For Solana only: "program" for Anchor/Rust programs, "token" for SPL token JSON config

use_learned_rules.description: Inject self-learning security rules into generation prompt

name: pentagonal_generate
